### Meaning
| infl. | class | meaning                                |
| ----- | ----- | -------------------------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*  | number, quantity, amount / measurement |
| ~en   | *v.*  | to count (tr.) / to measure (tr.)      |
### Implied meaning
- ordinal number of an item in a series (from toki pona)
### Etymology
#### Glyph
number sign \#, like sitelen pona "nanpa".
#### Sound
- *a priori:* n=logic, i=precision
